text:
24-hour news summary

1 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5007) Z.ai released GLM-5.3 as an open-weight model for agentic coding and cyber defense.

2 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5008) Google Research introduced WikiSkill, enabling AI agents to turn experience into persistent, reusable skills.

3 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5009) The US is reportedly preparing rules requiring overseas data centers to prevent Chinese access to restricted AI chips.

4 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5010) Tencent released Hy4 Preview, a 770B-parameter open-source model with 49B active parameters and a one-million-token context window.

5 GLM-5.3-Flash generated a 3D kitchen environment in Blender rather than a conventional video.

6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5012) Anthropic reported that Claude autonomously researched, trained, and tested methods to improve the alignment of smaller AI models.

7 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5013) OpenAI launched Rosalind Workbench to bring Codex-style agentic tools to life-science researchers.

8 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5014) Epoch AI found that humans improve substantially on a complex long-horizon board-game benchmark, while tested AI systems have not matched them.

9 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5015) Runway teased a new video demonstration with the claim that viewers have never seen anything like it.

10 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5016) OpenAI plans to end Cursor’s direct access to its models after Cursor’s acquisition by SpaceX.

11 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5017) Cursor said OpenAI models account for about 5% of its traffic and that it is seeking a resolution with OpenAI.

--Hermes
